description: Router Updates — add /missions and /select-location routes, update PlanetSelection navigation to go through /select-location, keep all existing guards. Depends on FEAT-D (MissionsOverviewScreen and LocationSelectionScreen needed). Small change — just router.tsx + a placeholder LocationSelectionScreen.
steps: 2. CREATE src/features/location-selection/LocationSelectionScreen.tsx — placeholder screen. AppShell variant='light'. Shows 'Location Selection — Coming Soon' heading with a list of 3 placeholder locations per planet (e.g. for Moon: 'Shackleton Crater', 'Mare Tranquillitatis', 'Aristarchus Plateau'; for Mars: 'Jezero Crater', 'Olympus Mons', 'Valles Marineris'). Each location is a Card that is clickable. When any location is clicked, it simply navigates to '/select-crew' (location data is display-only for now — no simulation effect). Include a Back button navigating to '/select-planet'. Export LocationSelectionScreen.

3. UPDATE src/app/router.tsx — make these changes only:
   a. Add lazy import for LocationSelectionScreen (same pattern as others: React.lazy(() => import('../features/location-selection/LocationSelectionScreen').then(m => ({ default: m.LocationSelectionScreen }))))
   b. Add lazy import for MissionsOverviewScreen (src/features/missions/MissionsOverviewScreen.tsx)
   c. Add route for '/select-location': wrap in Suspense + ScreenTransition (no guard — same as /select-crew which also has no guard in current router)
   d. Add route for '/missions': wrap in Suspense + ScreenTransition, NO guard (public screen)
   e. Update the '/select-planet' route: the Continue button in PlanetSelectionScreen now goes to '/select-location' — but router.tsx does not control button navigation (that is in PlanetSelectionScreen). The router update here is purely adding the new routes. Keep ALL existing routes exactly as they are.

4. UPDATE src/features/planet-selection/PlanetSelectionScreen.tsx — ONLY change the navigate('/select-crew') call to navigate('/select-location'). This is the only behavioral change: PlanetSelection → LocationSelection → CrewSelection. Update the Continue button aria-label from 'continue to crew selection' to 'continue to location selection'.
5. Run `npx vite build` — fix any TypeScript errors.

6. Run `npx vitest run` — check if the PlanetSelectionScreen test for 'Continue button navigates to /select-crew when clicked after selection' now fails. If so, update tests/unit/features/PlanetSelectionScreen.test.tsx to expect '/select-location' instead of '/select-crew' and update the aria-label selector. The test logic is the same, only the expected route and aria-label change.
acceptance_criteria: Navigating to /missions renders MissionsOverviewScreen (no guard, accessible without login)
npx vitest run reports 170+ tests passing
findings: Router already had /missions route from a prior step; only /select-location was missing. LocationSelectionScreen created with 3 Moon + 3 Mars placeholder locations (clickable cards, navigates to /select-crew). PlanetSelectionScreen navigate call updated from /select-crew to /select-location and aria-label updated to 'continue to location selection'. Two PlanetSelectionScreen tests updated to match new route and aria-label. Build: 0 TypeScript errors. Tests: 177/177 passed.
